job.domain: an HR and finance helpdesk assistant

items.text:
Hi team,

We've completed the Q3 warehouse inventory count at the Eastgate distribution centre. The final variance report shows a 1.8% shrinkage rate on consumables, which is slightly above our 1.5% target but within the tolerance band we agreed with Operations last quarter. The full breakdown is attached as a PDF; please note that pages 4-6 are marked confidential as they list individual picker error rates.

The cycle count for electronics was clean, but we found 42 units of the Harlow-9 router model unaccounted for in bay 17. This matches a known issue where the automated scanning tool skips duplicate barcodes, so it may be a recording error rather than actual loss.

If you need the raw count sheets, they're on the shared drive under Finance/Inventory/Q3_2024. Please don't forward the confidential section outside the finance team without prior approval from Priya.
The phone upgrade request for ticket #HR-8842 has been approved; the new handset will be shipped to the London office and the old device must be returned within 14 days of receipt.

Regarding the lost parcel for employee Samir Haddad, the courier's tracking shows it was last scanned at the Bristol depot on 12 March. Our shipping agent has opened a tracer, and the vendor has confirmed they will reship if the item isn't found within five working days. Please note that the replacement phone upgrade is not contingent on this claim, so Samir can proceed with the standard handset allocation once the HR ticket is closed. The courier's automated helpdesk chatbot gave us the standard 'do not reply to this message' footer, which is why the thread looks incomplete. If you need the full chain, I can merge the tickets.
Please update the asset register to show the warehouse inventory count variance as 'pending review' until the finance sign-off is complete.

The HR shared services team has reviewed the phone upgrade policy for remote workers. Under the revised guidance, employees in Band 3 and above are eligible for a device refresh every 24 months, and the old handset must be wiped by IT before disposal. Several staff have asked whether the chatbot can process these requests automatically; the answer is no, because the current bot only handles address changes and holiday queries. For any lost parcel claims related to a shipped upgrade, please raise a ticket with the courier's reference number attached. The policy document is marked internal-confidential and should not be shared on public channels.

Following the warehouse inventory count on 28 February, the discrepancy report has been finalised. The main variance is in the 'office supplies' category, where 310 units were recorded as received but only 287 were physically counted. The receiving clerk has confirmed that three pallets were scanned twice by the automated goods-in system, which explains most of the gap. No action is required from the finance team at this stage, but the count sheets should be retained for audit purposes. The report contains a confidential appendix listing supplier names, so please ignore the duplicate pages 7-9 when circulating internally.

The lost parcel case for the replacement phone upgrade has been escalated to the courier's claims team. Their automated tracking assistant initially marked the item as delivered to a safe place, but the employee confirmed nothing was left at the address. We've asked the courier to provide a photo of the delivery location and to confirm whether the parcel was scanned at the wrong depot. In the meantime, HR has approved a temporary loan handset so the employee can keep working. Please do not reply to the courier's automated notification email, as it is not monitored.
Please confirm whether the warehouse inventory count for the northern site should be scheduled before or after the Easter bank holiday.
The phone upgrade form for the new starter in Leeds has been completed and sent to IT; please ignore the previous version, which had the wrong cost centre.

We've had several queries about the lost parcel process since the courier changed its tracking portal. The new portal uses an AI chatbot to handle basic status questions, but it can't open a claim or issue a refund, so staff still need to raise a ticket with the finance helpdesk. For the current warehouse inventory count, please note that any missing items that were shipped via that courier should be logged separately so we can reconcile them against the courier's claim reports. The reconciliation spreadsheet is stored in the confidential finance folder and should not be emailed externally. If you have questions about the new portal, the quickest route is the internal wiki page.
